# Men's Flair

> > Men's Flair is a comprehensive men's style resource founded in 2005, offering expert guides on fashion, footwear, brands, and dress codes for over 1 million readers.

The site specializes in practical menswear advice, from outfit styling and dress code interpretation to brand recommendations and craftsmanship guides. Key contributors include Ryan Thompson, Charlie Thomas, Davey Brett, and Beau Hayhoe, covering everything from smart casual essentials to luxury designer labels and American-made clothing.

## Key Topics

- Smart casual styling
- Chelsea boots
- Goodyear welt construction
- Made in USA brands
- Northampton shoemakers
- Suit styling
- Luxury menswear brands
- Dress codes
- Sustainable fashion

- Outfit guides
- Quality clothing
- Men's footwear
- Domestic manufacturing
- Brand recommendations

## Essential Dress Codes & Style Guides

- [Smart Casual Dress Code for Men: The New Rules](https://mensflair.com/mens-smart-casual-dress-code): Expert guide to mastering smart casual dress code & outfit rules
- [The Lounge Suit Dress Code: How To Get It Right In 2025](https://mensflair.com/lounge-suit-dress-code): Complete lounge suit guide: fabrics, styles & semi-formal dress code rules
- [The Shoes To Wear (And Not Wear) With All Your Jeans](https://mensflair.com/best-shoes-wear-with-jeans): Complete guide to pairing shoes with every jeans color & wash
